subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------ALT.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 135 (AE(PD)-23). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-DY (extended dynamics), PART (participation) and MOT-DY. From EXT-DY: SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From PART: POL-DY (political dynamics) and INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From MOT-DY: WO-UNF (world unification). From SCI-DY: APL-DT (application dictates). From POL-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From INFO-SOLD: HI-P (high purpose). From WO-UNF: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism).
